name: qe-edu
description: QE-style education WordPress theme (qe-edu) and companion plugin (qe-edu-core).

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: sass --no-source-map --style=compressed theme/qe-edu/assets/scss/main.scss theme/qe-edu/assets/css/main.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed theme/qe-edu/assets/scss/editor.scss theme/qe-edu/assets/css/editor.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed plugin/qe-edu-core/assets/scss/widgets.scss plugin/qe-edu-core/assets/css/widgets.css && sass --no-source-map --style=compressed plugin/qe-edu-core/assets/scss/admin.scss plugin/qe-edu-core/assets/css/admin.css
scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:php
